name: Bellocco
summary:
Bellocco is a free browser-based mafia strategy MMO with no download required. Players build a criminal empire from the ground up: recruiting a family, running businesses, committing crimes, smuggling goods, and battling rival families for territory and respect.

The game is built around persistent, ongoing progression rather than session-based play - players check in periodically to manage their operations, train their crew, and plan attacks, with a seasonal leaderboard that resets periodically to keep competition fresh. It is played entirely in the browser and is available in English and Dutch.
